notes: Fixes sign-in and relay connection. v0.10.1 shipped three changes that only work together with a TLS deployment that was never performed: accounts traffic aimed at port 443, an HTTPS-only requirement, and full CA verification of the relay certificate. Each one blocked operators in turn — ECONNREFUSED, then "must use HTTPS", then "self signed certificate". Mumble servers are self-signed by design, so the relay is now verified the way Mumble clients actually do it: trust on first use, then pin the certificate and refuse it if it ever changes. Plain-HTTP accounts traffic is permitted and clearly labelled as unencrypted rather than blocked, and the accounts address is editable under SYS > NETWORK. No server change required.
